note: The filed bill (trámite 450889, 20 Jun 2024, Patricia Núñez) is well supported, and the Assembly releases support the committee report and the Plenary's archiving on 15 Sep 2026. But the web search shows the Education committee unified three 2024 initiatives (Núñez, Subía, Correa) into a new text in 2025, so the text archived may not be the Núñez bill the summary and the 83-article description rest on. No stored file settles this (the extractor's own note says so). A human should decide whether the record is the Núñez filing, whose later fate was archiving of a unified text, or the unified text. Also found: the Assembly's release of 1 Sep 2026 on a new bill by Cecilia Baltazar on AI use (a separate instrument, a lead).
